_comment: South Dakota 2026-27 QAP, SDHDA, approved 15 June 2026. Scoring is Section V, Project Selection Criteria, PDF pp.19-25, organised in five lettered groups: A Primary Selection Criteria, B Readiness to Proceed, C Project Characteristics, D Tenant Ownership, E Local Housing Need. Page numbers are PDF page indices; the printed numbers run one lower.

track_totals.note: No maximum is stated. The operative figure is a floor: 'Applications must obtain a minimum of 400 points to be considered for award, other than those for additional tax credits.' Summing the stated section maxima gives 800, so the floor sits at half of the available points. Two criteria are scored against the round rather than a fixed standard: Project Characteristics defers entirely to Exhibit 4, and Local Housing Need awards the highest score to the greatest assessed need.

groups.label: Extended use commitment against tenant ownership
groups.source_quote: are ineligible to claim points for Tenant Ownership
groups.note: Stated from both ends: the extended use criterion says such applicants are ineligible for tenant ownership points, and the tenant ownership criterion says the reverse. Both are worth 20.

criteria.heading: Deep income targeting
criteria.quote: Within the 20/50, 40/60, or Average Income election, to receive points for deep income targeting

tiers.tier_label: 20% of rent restricted units at 50% AMI, rents at the lesser of FMR or 50% AMI
A further 10% of units for households at or below 50% AMI
A further 7% of units at or below 40% AMI
A further 3% of units at or below 30% AMI

criteria.note: Cumulative, not alternative: the QAP states each point category must be in addition to the preceding one, so all four together make the 100. Housing Trust Fund units count toward the 30% AMI tier only where there is at least one more 30% unit than HTF funding requires.

criteria.heading: Extended use commitment
criteria.quote: commit to increase the Extended Use Period an additional 10 years
criteria.note: Taking the affordability period to 40 years. Claiming this forfeits tenant ownership points.

criteria.heading: Construction type
criteria.quote: A rehabilitation project that remodels existing affordable rental housing to like new rental

tiers.tier_label: Rehabilitation remodelling existing affordable rental housing to like new
Rehabilitation using buildings of historic nature
Rehabilitation converting existing buildings to new rental units
Designated senior housing, 55 and over or 62 and over

criteria.note: Four items totalling 100 against a stated maximum of 60, so a project can combine at most some of them. Note the structure favours rehabilitation heavily: three of the four routes require an existing building.

criteria.heading: Concerted community revitalization plan
criteria.quote: located within a Qualified Census Tract (QCT) and that contribute to a Concerted
criteria.note: The plan must be documented at the time of application.

criteria.heading: Third-party financial support
criteria.quote: documentation of financing or incentives from third party individuals

tiers.tier_label: $10,001 or more per unit
$5,001 to $10,000 per unit
$1,000 to $5,000 per unit

criteria.note: Support that reduces development costs or enhances feasibility. The bands leave a gap between $10,000 and $10,001, and nothing below $1,000.

criteria.heading: Applicant characteristics
criteria.quote: SDHDA will award the points indicated for each documented characteristic

tiers.tier_label: Demonstrated track record in developing or managing subsidised housing
Enterprise at least 51% owned or operated by a minority individual or a woman
Owner equity above 10% of total development cost, not a deferred developer fee

criteria.note: Additive to the stated 40-point maximum. Where a consultant provides the track record, their services must run through issuance of Form 8609 and the contract must be in the application.

criteria.heading: Unapproved changes or unresolved compliance issues
criteria.quote: SDHDA will deduct 25 points from where applicant or any member of the development
criteria.note: Applies to a significant change made to another SDHDA-administered project without approval within the past two years, or unresolved compliance issues. An applicant in either position is also barred from the 20-point track record award, so the effective swing is 45 points.

criteria.heading: Applied for additional funding after an initial reservation
criteria.quote: SDHDA will deduct 10 points for any project whose developer/owner applied for additional
criteria.note: Applies for the two annual rounds following the request. Unlike the 25-point deduction, this one leaves the track record points intact.

criteria.heading: Service enriched housing
criteria.quote: Projects that provide verifiable full-time, on-site services to the tenants
criteria.note: The QAP states no sub-criteria for how the 30 points are apportioned.

criteria.heading: Percentage of soft costs
criteria.quote: Soft costs include but are not limited to developers

tiers.tier_label: Soft costs 0.00% to 9.99%
19.01% and above

criteria.note: Builder's profit is excluded from soft costs. The bands leave a gap between 19.00% and 19.01%.

criteria.heading: Proximity to community services or transport
criteria.quote: The property is within one half mile of community services

tiers.tier_label: Bus stop within one city block, or free scheduled or on-call transport for tenants
On-call transport provided at reduced rates
Grocery or retail store within half a mile
Hospital or medical clinic within half a mile
School, or senior centre for senior properties, within half a mile
Special service offices within half a mile

criteria.note: Two routes to the same 20 points: four services at 5 each, or the transport provision alone.

criteria.heading: Area of opportunity
criteria.quote: Area of Opportunity (5 points for each achieved)

tiers.tier_label: Low poverty census tract, under 10% poverty
Ratio of jobs to population above the state average
Unemployment below the state rate
School performance index above average

criteria.heading: Households with children
criteria.quote: at least 50% of units containing two or more bedrooms

criteria.heading: Public housing notification and waiting list priority
criteria.quote: notify local public housing agencies of vacancies and give

criteria.heading: Plans and specifications
criteria.quote: architectural plans/working drawings that are at least 50% complete
criteria.note: Or a physical needs assessment completed by an independent third party.

criteria.heading: Site control
criteria.quote: a recorded warranty deed, a recorded long-term lease, or an approval of Transfer

tiers.tier_label: Recorded warranty deed, recorded long-term lease, or approved transfer of physical assets
Enforceable signed and accepted purchase agreement or option to buy

criteria.heading: Financing commitments
criteria.quote: Construction Financing (20 points maximum)

tiers.tier_label: Construction or interim financing commitment
Permanent financing, fixed rate, term of 15 years or more
Permanent financing, fixed rate, term under 15 years
Equity commitment disclosing all conditions

criteria.note: Three components of 20 each make the 60. The equity commitment must carry the investor's acknowledgement that it has reviewed the application and accepts the rent, income and use restrictions.

criteria.heading: Utilities at or adjacent to the site
criteria.quote: for documentation from each provider

tiers.tier_label: Water provider confirmation
Sewer provider confirmation
Electricity provider confirmation
Heat provider confirmation, electric, natural gas or fuel oil

criteria.note: Each provider must confirm the utility is currently at or immediately adjacent to the site with capacity for the project. Close proximity, or that a utility could be extended, does not qualify.

criteria.heading: Zoning
criteria.quote: the project site is properly zoned or that zoning is not

criteria.heading: Platting
criteria.quote: the final plat of the land has been recorded

criteria.heading: Project characteristics
criteria.quote: Applications will receive up to 100 points as detailed in Exhibit 4
criteria.note: A hundred points, an eighth of everything available, with no criteria stated in the QAP at all. Exhibit 4 is a separate document and is not in the corpus, so nothing beyond the maximum is extractable here.

criteria.heading: Tenant ownership, lease purchase
criteria.quote: Projects intended for eventual tenant ownership will receive 20 points
criteria.note: Requires a management plan covering homebuyer counselling and the calculation of the future purchase price. Claiming this forfeits the extended use commitment points.

criteria.heading: Local housing need
criteria.quote: SDHDA will award the highest score to projects considered to be facing the highest overall need
criteria.note: Scored against the round and at SDHDA's assessment, with no stated method. Communities with two or more low-income projects under construction or still in rent-up below 90% occupancy may receive zero.

criteria.heading: Minimum 400 points
criteria.quote: Applications must obtain a minimum of 400 points to be considered for award
criteria.note: Applications for additional tax credits are exempt and are judged on the applicable criteria instead.
